summary: Phase 2 Backend Testing: Subscription & Seller Features. Found 2 CRITICAL bugs preventing authenticated endpoints from working: (1) _get_current_user function mismatch, (2) users_router and webhooks_router not included in API. 15 tests passed, 10 skipped due to known bugs.

critical.issue: _get_current_user(credentials) called but function expects (Request, credentials). Causes AttributeError: 'HTTPAuthorizationCredentials' object has no attribute 'cookies'
critical.fix: Add Request parameter to route signatures: async def endpoint(request: Request, credentials: ...) and call _get_current_user(request, credentials)

critical.issue: users_router NOT included in api_router (see server.py line 10737-10740). All endpoints in routes/users.py return 404.
critical.fix: Add api_router.include_router(users_router) to server.py after resolving duplicate endpoint conflicts

critical.issue: webhooks_router NOT included in api_router. Webhook cannot receive Stripe subscription events.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Update payments.py routes to pass Request object to _get_current_user. Change from _get_current_user(credentials) to _get_current_user(request, credentials) and add Request parameter to route signatures
FIX CRITICAL: Include users_router in api_router to expose Stripe Connect onboarding endpoints
FIX CRITICAL: Include webhooks_router in api_router to receive Stripe subscription webhook events
After fixes, retest all 10 skipped tests
critical_code_review_comments: Subscription tier mappings correctly defined in subscription_service.py with correct Stripe Price IDs
Fee rates by tier are correctly configured (Free: 5%/4%, Premium: 3.5%/2.5%, VIP: 3%/2%)
Processing fee info endpoint works correctly (2.9% + $0.30)
Subscription upgrade endpoint structure is correct, creates Stripe checkout session
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 subscription and seller endpoints have critical bugs. All authenticated endpoints in payments.py fail due to incorrect _get_current_user call. Stripe Connect and Webhook routes are not registered (404). After main agent fixes these 3 issues, rerun test_phase2_subscription_seller.py to validate all 25 tests.

bug_1.title: _get_current_user function parameter mismatch
bug_1.root_cause: Routes call _get_current_user(credentials) but the function in server.py expects (request: Request, credentials). The function tries to access request.cookies which fails on HTTPAuthorizationCredentials object.
fix_steps: 1. Add 'from fastapi import Request' if not already imported
2. Update each route signature to include Request: async def endpoint(request: Request, ...)

bug_2.title: users_router not included in api_router
bug_2.root_cause: Comment indicates users_router not included due to duplicate endpoints. New Stripe Connect endpoints added to routes/users.py are therefore inaccessible.
fix_steps: 2. Alternatively, move Stripe Connect endpoints to server.py or payments_router

bug_3.title: webhooks_router not included in api_router
bug_3.root_cause: webhooks_router imported but not included. Stripe webhook events cannot be received.

working_endpoints: GET /api/payments/subscriptions/tiers - Returns all tiers with correct Stripe Price IDs
POST /api/payments/subscriptions/upgrade - Creates Stripe checkout (requires valid tier)
